camera_report.description: Restricted BA: four poses + shared width/depth. H0 height and all FOVs fixed.
warnings: Joint fitting does not establish absolute metric accuracy or replace survey data.
RMSE uses fitted points; validate using corners or edges excluded from fitting.
An incorrect prism footprint can bias all fitted camera poses.
Only REAL observed structural edges provide angular constraints; VP guides are not independent evidence.

notes: Existing photographs and historical runs were not overwritten.
Saved 2.5D neighbor coordinates must be reviewed after geometry changes.
PnP fitting error is not independent metric ground truth.
